Privacy Policy

Information you provide

The inquiry forms ask for your name, email address, phone number, subject, and message. The form puts the details you enter into a draft in your email app. Aegis CyberWorks receives those details when you send the email. We use the information you send to respond to your inquiry and follow up on your request. Please leave out passwords, access keys, and confidential system details.

Hosting, maps, and display preferences

The website remembers your light or dark theme in your browser. You can clear this preference in your browser settings. The hosting provider may process technical information such as your IP address and request details to deliver and protect the site. Pages that load Google Fonts or Google Maps connect to Google. External links, including LinkedIn and YouTube, take you to services with their own privacy policies.

See the Netlify Privacy Statement, GitHub Privacy Statement, and Google Privacy Policy for information about those providers.

Questions about your information

Email info@aegiscyberworks.com to ask how we handle your inquiry or to request access, correction, or deletion of information you sent us.
